correctness.rationale: The language has equality, constant e and ternary multiplication relation, not a binary function. Rank-two EF equivalence is determined by the sets T(G) of second-move atomic diagrams U_G(x); all atomic relations in x,y,e reduce by cancellation to eight stated Boolean predicates x=e,y=e,x=y,x²=e,y²=e,x²=y,y²=x,xy=e. Write affine maps (a,b)(c,d)=(ac,b+ad). By conjugating a nontranslation to (γ^j,0), reducing a nonzero translation to (1,b), and treating identity, explicit formulas enumerate all eight-bit diagrams. The modular 2h≡j conditions, low multiplier orders 2,3,4 and generic high orders separate the p=2, p=3 and p≥5 arithmetic regimes; the proof identifies the fifteen row conditions, excluding additional q classes. Independent literal affine finite-field multiplication found all 15 designated representatives pairwise inequivalent (including q=81); additional prime field signatures checked p≤31. Those finite checks verify class separation and formulas but are not an all-prime-power exhaustive proof. The uniform type reduction is essential.
